title: Recent Load and the Billing Basis of a Business Security Deposit
content:
The monthly bill figure on which the recalculated requirement of a held business Security Deposit rests, its billing basis, follows the secured Electric Service Agreement's recent load.

**Definitions.** All means are of the agreement's regular bills issued in the stated months ending on the recalculation date, each mean rounded to the cent.
- **Twelve-month mean**: mean of the regular bills issued in the 12 months ending on the recalculation date.
- **Recent mean**: mean of the regular bills issued in the 3 months ending on the recalculation date.
- **Six-month mean**: mean of the regular bills issued in the 6 months ending on the recalculation date.
- **Average billing demand**: the billing demand (kW) of the twelve-month regular bills averaged over those bills; the latest billing demand is the billing demand on the agreement's latest regular bill.

**Rule.**

| Recent load on the Electric Service Agreement | Billing basis |
|---|---|
| The recent mean exceeds the twelve-month mean times 1.25, and the latest billing demand exceeds the average billing demand | The recent mean |
| The recent mean is below the twelve-month mean times 0.75, and the latest billing demand is below the average billing demand | The six-month mean |
| Otherwise | The twelve-month mean |

The billing basis so chosen, rounded to the cent, is the average monthly bill recorded on the deposit with the recalculated requirement.

## Cases (hypothetical agreement: twelve-month mean USD 3000.00, average billing demand 180.0 kW)

| Recent mean (USD) | Latest billing demand (kW) | Six-month mean (USD) | Billing basis (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4000.00 (above 3750.00) | 210.0 | 3500.00 | 4000.00 |
| 3700.00 (not above 3750.00) | 210.0 | 3400.00 | 3000.00 |
| 2000.00 (below 2250.00) | 150.0 | 2400.00 | 2400.00 |
| 2000.00 (below 2250.00) | 190.0 | 2400.00 | 3000.00 |
